evidence: Independent read-only Python validation parsed every shipped JSON (two seed copies and package.json; no CSV/TSV files). The seed copies are byte-identical, SHA256 1b39015461a7a4f23b835aeea9584caffd0266c64d394778376cbd6c8a18bcf7. All task and frozen-rule file hashes matched manifest.json; qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md matched its frozen engine hash. Under the frozen task root, environment/assets/seed_data.json:26-459 contains 3 employees, 7 users, 7 requisitions, 13 offers, 8 commitment rows, 1 grant, 2 signing remittances and 2 referral accruals. Checked unique entity IDs and user emails; every offer requisition/referrer/creator/approver and every ancillary offer/requisition/employee reference resolves. Every COMMITTED offer has exactly the applicable commitment, grant, signing and referral records; noncommitted offers have no settlement rows. All eight commitment amounts equal the negative independently calculated base-plus-rounded-annualized-intrinsic run-rate. Grant terms/date, signing amounts, and referral candidate/referrer/start match their offers. All 122 numeric values are exact safe integers, with negative values only in signed movements; all 32 UTC timestamps parse. Constants at seed lines 4-24 match hireops_rules.md composition, bands, vesting and referral rules. Manual inspection of the complete seed plus a text scan found no payload, secret, password field or live credential; all seven account addresses use hireops.example (lines 40-90), and remaining identity data is synthetic fixture names/IDs without real contact details. The public demo password is documented outside the seed and is expected by the skill. Intentional stale planning scalars at lines 91-147 are expressly non-authoritative under hireops_rules.md:191-193, so they are not inconsistent ledger balances. Mutation controls on in-memory copies correctly detected an unresolved requisition and a one-cent wrong commitment. A broken app trusting the stale scalar could show wrong headroom, but that does not invalidate the clean seed; computed actual headrooms are 24000000, 5300000, 3000000, 15000000, 80000000, 30000000, and 25000000 cents in requisition order. The conforming alternative of an empty operational desk remains allowed by instruction.md:11 and hireops_rules.md:89-95; retaining the required users/employees/constants/clock while omitting operational lists was checked in memory and is not treated as a failure. This is direct seed inspection and local validation, not a private checker run, configured judge run, Oracle/model score or portal result; none is needed to establish this row-specific data property.
